brief.summary: US equity futures are higher, led by AI-linked names after SpaceX and Supermicro beats; S&P and Nasdaq futures gained modestly. Rates show front-end yields anchored near 4.7-4.8% and long-end yields up slightly this morning but lower over the past week, with no clear curve steepening. The Fed is widely expected to hold next week, though markets price about 15% odds of an October hike and speakers debate broadening inflation. Oil is elevated around $111 Brent, adding fuel-cost and geopolitical risk. The dominant narrative is still AI earnings durability versus financing and data-center political risks. Tone is risk-on in US tech but cautious on Europe, consumer pockets, and geopolitics.
